liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Deal** (1 review): Reviewer says only the first set's closing Deal was good; the rest was boring [10]
- **Ship Of Fools** (1 review): Reviewer likes this version of Ship of Fools, specifically Jerry's solo [19]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Black Peter absolutely smokes as Jerry goes off; Victim and Eyes are also nice [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-06-09.150594.sbd.miller.flac2448** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 150 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1992-06-09.sbd.miller.89985.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 151 min; rated 2.5/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound problems in first set; Deal is the highlight, while Victim is snoozy [19]
- **gd1992-06-09.150703.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 150 min [3]
- **gd1992-06-09.164803.nak300.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 150 min [4]
- **gd1992-06-09.141250.FOB-BK4011.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 18 songs; 157 min [6]
- **gd92-06-09.schoeps-akg.stevens.12574.sbeok.flacf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 147 min; rated 2.73/5 by 11 [7]. Said about its sound: Eyes is very nice; Vince is well balanced in the mix, not too front; Jerry's final solo in Eyes was inaudible due to new digital PA issues [11][20]

## Around the show

- Reviewer sat second row, face to face with Jerry, who looked distracted and disgusted [12]
- Reviewer's brother waited outside an OSU lecture hall while they finished a chemistry final [13]
- Bob spat on the reviewer's face after they blew a rip during Victim [14]
- A band member handed the reviewer and their friend one backstage pass after the show [15]
- Reviewer boarded the tour bus at this stop, making the Miller soundboard special [21]
- This was the closest performance to the blizzard show; other Richfield dates were better [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-06-09.150594.sbd.miller.flac2448**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  September 21, 2020; source: SBD > DAT Master (Panasonic SV-3700/48k) > Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [1]
- **gd1992-06-09.sbd.miller.89985.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) D [2]
- **gd1992-06-09.150703.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  September 21, 2020; source: SBD > DAT Master (Panasonic SV-3700/48k) > Cassette Master (Tascam 122mkIII/TDK SA-X100) [3]
- **gd1992-06-09.164803.nak300.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics > Sony D5M [4]. Also: Michael Hessberg provided master cassette; Dan Stevens' AKG 568 source patches Drums [4]
- **gd1992-06-09.141250.FOB-BK4011.ebel.flac1644**: taped by Clay and Jamie?; transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16/44.1 Source Info: FOB B&K 4011-> DAT (Clay and Jamie?).Transfer Info: Dat Tape (Panasonic SV-3700)-> Marantz CDR-615-> CD (Late 90's)Extract Wav-> Flac… [6]. Also: FOB recording using B+K 4011 microphones, transferred to 16-bit 44.1kHz FLAC [6]
- **gd92-06-09.schoeps-akg.stevens.12574.sbeok.flacf**: source: Set I: AUD, FOB Schoeps CMC32's ; Set II: AUD, OTS AKG 568's [7]
